# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release on `main` is supported. Please update to the latest version before reporting a security issue — it may already be fixed.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for a security vulnerability. Instead, use GitHub's private reporting:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/N6LKA/ASL3-Herald/security) of this repository
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**
3. Fill in as much detail as you can (steps to reproduce, affected version, potential impact)

This opens a private conversation that only you and the maintainer can see, so the issue can be assessed and fixed before it's made public.

I'll do my best to respond promptly and keep you updated as the issue is investigated and resolved.
